title: Building Code First AI Agents with Azure AI Agent Service — Cedric Vidal, Microsoft
talk_summary: A workshop on Azure AI Agent Service showing stateful agents, function calling, file search, code interpreter, and Bing grounding. The transferable lessons are agent-design mechanics: tool schemas, specialization/routing, explicit done criteria, deterministic tools, schema grounding, and trajectory evals.

takeaways.technique: Tool schemas and docstrings as grounding
takeaways.what_they_do: The LLM selects tools from JSON schemas and Python docstrings; verbose agent instructions are optional because the tool contract itself grounds selection.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the tool is comes with its own schema and the lm is going to understand the JSON schema

takeaways.technique: Specialize agents by tool area and route
takeaways.what_they_do: Giving one agent all tools raises the chance of wrong selection; classify the request and route to a specialized agent with fewer tools.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the probability that it gets it wrong is higher Right. Um so the solution to that is to create agents which are more specialized

takeaways.technique: Explicit definition of done and stop criteria
takeaways.what_they_do: Looping agents need a done criterion, implemented deterministically or by an LLM judge, or they do not know when to stop.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you need to define a criteria of done a definition of done basically

takeaways.technique: Dedicated deterministic calculator over LLM math
takeaways.what_they_do: LLMs are unreliable at arithmetic; delegate math to a calculator/tool, while code interpreter is better for diagrams and file parsing.
takeaways.evidence_quote: when you need to do math, you need to use a tool

takeaways.technique: Inject compact schema/API maps and enforce security in code
takeaways.what_they_do: The agent is grounded by putting the database schema in instructions; cryptic schemas must be documented semantically, and confidentiality must be enforced like normal code.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the instructions of the agents is going to contain what the schema of the database is

takeaways.technique: Evaluate tool trajectories, not just final answers
takeaways.what_they_do: Agent evaluation must cover the whole conversation and whether the right tools were selected, not only the final response.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you need to evaluate whether the good tool the accuracy of which tools were selected
